propositions: Cloud and Data Center Jira adapters have asymmetric test coverage: Cloud has incident-derived byte-for-byte characterization pins and ADF depth tests, while DC has pagination proofs, rate-limit handling, and TLS validation that Cloud lacks
DC adapter's field values and sanitizer boundaries are not pinned by value in tests, only by shape, leaving the contract unverified against actual production behavior

DC comment and description length convergence is untested across multiple passes, and the comment ceiling's provenance is not cited in code, making the constant appear as an assumption rather than a documented decision
A duplicated ticket-type map exists in adapters/ with no regression guard preventing a second copy from appearing, unlike existing guards on status and priority maps
Multiple test cases in the DC suite are vacuous and do not assert the contracts their docstrings name, providing false confidence in coverage
